question: Which of the following countries borders India to the north-west?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Afghanistan and Pakistan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Afghanistan and Pakistan** are the countries that border India to the north-west.
 
• Pakistan shares a long border with India along the states of Jammu & Kashmir, Punjab, Rajasthan, and Gujarat.
 
• Afghanistan shares a shorter border with India, located at the north-western tip of Jammu & Kashmir, known as the Wakhan Corridor.
 
• This region is strategically significant for India due to its geopolitical and security implications.
 
• The border with Pakistan has been a focal point of various historical and political tensions between the two nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India** is bordered by several countries including China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar.
 
• To the north, India shares a long border with China, spanning the states of Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, and Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• To the east, India shares borders with Bangladesh and Myanmar.
 
• India's border with Nepal and Bhutan lies to the north and north-east of the country.
 
• Each of these borders has its unique geopolitical and cultural significance, influencing India's foreign policy and regional dynamics.
